note: Router codegen and build cache: duplicate (method, path) routes and routes overlapping a merged child app are compile errors (with or without a spec); export_app specs are crate-scoped, merge resolves use aliases and checks the merged app at compile time; include_str sidecars are content-addressed and written atomically; route(path = "/") maps to the file path without a trailing slash; unknown route keys list the valid ones; duplicate tags / security_schemes are errors and declared tags keep their order; dir must be a module folder under src/ (nested "api/v1" supported); symlinked route files are followed; src/<dir>.rs edits and inline-module handlers are tracked; cron jobs in src/bin crates get their real module path.
